- 2023 revenue (comparable basis): $24,610 million [DOC: mmm_fy2024_income_statement.txt]  
- 2024 revenue: $24,575 million [DOC: mmm_fy2024_income_statement.txt]  

ANSWER: 3M’s revenue growth from fiscal year 2023 to fiscal year 2024 was approximately -0.1% (a 0.14% decline) on a comparable basis.
